unitRules.name: Anathema
unitRules.text:
A Unit which includes any Models with this Special Rule may never be selected as the target of a Psychic Blessing or Psychic Curse, and Models with this Special Rule ignore all Damage inflicted by Psychic Weapons, Psychic Powers, Psychic Reactions or Perils of the Warp. If such a Model is selected as the Target Model of any attack or wound inflicted by a Psychic Weapon, Psychic Power, Psychic Reaction, or Perils of the Warp then all Damage caused has no effect and no Wound Tests, Armour Saves or Damage Mitigation Tests are made.

Additionally, Wound Tests made for Weapons with the Psychic or Immaterial Trait that target any Unit that includes only Models with this Special Rule that have an unmodified result of 1, 2, 3 or 4 are never successful, regardless of the Strength Characteristic of a Hit or any Special Rules that set the Target Number for Wound Tests. This Special Rule has no effect on Armour Penetration Tests.

unitRules.name: Help me… Please…
unitRules.text:
Damage inflicted to models with this special rule is not counted when calculating Combat Resolution.

If, at any point, a unit only includes models with this Special Rule, all models in that unit are removed as casualties and that Unit is destroyed.

unitRules.text: Whilst Lelith is in base contact with any Enemy Models that have a Weapon Skill characteristic, and all of those Models have a lower Weapon Skill Characteristic than she does, her Attacks Characteristic is increased by the difference between her Weapon Skill and the Lowest Weapon Skill amongst Enemy Models in base contact with her. While a Model with this Special Rule is engaged in a Challenge, its Controlling Player can select the following Gambit for that Model:

At Last, A Challenge!: If this Gambit is selected, Lelith's Base Initiative Characteristic becomes equal to that of her opponent during the Focus Step. When selecting The Penetrating Blades as the provisions for an Attack during the Strike Step, that Attack gains the Critical Hits (4+) Special Rule, instead of 6+.

unitRules.name: Natural Perfection
unitRules.text: Lelith is not affected by special rules that negatively modify her Characteristics (other than Wounds).

unitRules.name: Quicksilver Dodge
unitRules.text: Lelith's Invulnerable Save characteristic is increased to 3+ against all Attacks made as part of a Reaction and all Melee Attacks.

unitRules.name: Spectacular Displays
unitRules.text:
For each Melee Attack made by Lelith, the Controlling Player must select one of the following provisions to apply to that Attack:
• Barbed Mane: The Attack gains the Shred (4+) and Ensnare (1) Special Rules.
• The Penetrating Blades: The Attack gains the Critical Hits (6+) Special Rule and is resolved at AP2.

units.name: Urien Rakarth

unitRules.name: Contempt for Death
unitRules.text: At the start of each of the Controlling Player's turns, Urien gains 1 Wound. This cannot bring him above his base Wounds value.

unitRules.name: Father of Pain
unitRules.text:
When Urien's Fleshcraft (X) Special Rule is activated, an Enemy Model with the Infantry, Cavalry or Paragon Type within 6" of Urien may be selected as the Target Model instead of a friendly Model. If doing so, and the Intelligence Test is succesful, then the following option must be chosen instead of Reknit or Restore:
• Ravage: The Target Model's Controlling Player must make a Willpower check for that model with a penalty equal to the value of X associated with the variant of Fleshcraft (X) associated with the Acting Model. If failed, the Controlling Player of the Acting Model places a Pinned, Suppressed, or Stunned Token (their choice) on the Acting Model.

units.note: Casket of Flensing, Haemonculus Tool, Ichor Injector and Clone Field are listed as Wargear but no profile/rules text is printed on these pages; they are standard items defined elsewhere. units.name: Keradruakh

unitRules.name: Hunter of Heads
unitRules.text:
Keradruakh may only join units of Mandrakes.

If Keradruakh is selected as part of an army, the Controlling Player may select a Recon Slot in the same Army. That Recon Slot becomes a Prime Slot. Units of Mandrakes that are selected to fill that Slot may have the following Prime Advantage selected for them:

Court of Aelindrach (Prime Advantage): All Mandrakes in a Unit that has had this Prime Advantage selected for it gain +1 to their WS Characteristic. While Keradruakh has joined that Unit, all Mandrakes in that Unit gain the Shade Stalker Special Rule.

unitRules.name: Shade Stalker
unitRules.text:
Before the start of battle, the Controlling Player may select a Model with the Command or High Command Battlefield Role in the opposing Army. That model is referred to as The Prized Skull. If a friendly Unit enters the battlefield from reserves, and all Models in that Unit have the Shade Stalker Special Rule, then instead of entering the battlefield from reserves normally the Controlling Player may place all Models in that Unit anywhere on the battlefield that is within 12" of The Prized Skull and more than 3" from other models and terrain. The Intercept Reaction may be used as normal.
If the Unit declares a charge in the same turn that it enters the battlefield in this way, that charge is automatically disordered and only the unit that includes The Prized Skull may be selected as a charge target.

While engaged in a Challenge with The Prized Skull, if the Finishing Blow Gambit is selected for Keradruakh, the controlling player can discard the dice with the lowest result in the Focus Step, rather than the highest. However, if Keradruakh fails to destroy The Prized Skull with his attacks during the Strike Step, he automatically gains the Disgraced status and the controlling player gains no Combat Resolution points in the Glory step even if Keradruakh won the challenge.

units.name: Baron Sathonyx

unitRules.name: Bones of the Seer
unitRules.text: Once per turn, when Sathonyx's unit is selected as the Reactive Unit for a Reaction, the controlling player can choose to regain 1 point of Reaction Allotment after the Reaction has been resolved.

unitRules.name: The Lord Hellion
unitRules.text:
Sathonyx may only join Hellion Gangs and may not join other units.

One Recon Slot in the same army as Baron Sathonyx may be upgraded to a Prime Slot at no additional cost. That Prime Slot must be filled with a Hellion Gang, and the following Prime Advantage must be selected for it:

Twilight Shrouded: Only Sathonyx may join a Unit with this Prime Advantage. All models in the Unit with this Prime Advantage gain the Shrouded (5+) Special Rule.

units.note: Special Rules bullet list on page 99 gives this character's Traits sub-heading as 'Dracon' (the Dracon partisan/rank trait), printed above the Xenos/Drukhari/Cults trait bullets; not transcribed as a Trait entry since it labels the Cults choice rather than naming an additional Trait. Hellglaive, Splinter Pistol, Splinter Pod, Phantasm Grenade Launcher, Plasma Grenades and Shadow Field are listed as Wargear but no profile/rules text is printed on this page.

units.name: Duke Sliscus

unitRules.name: The Serpent's Venom
unitRules.text:
If Sliscus is selected as part of an army, the controlling player can select one Secondary or Apex Detachment in that army. The following Prime Advantages can be selected for units in that are selected to fill Prime Slots in that Detachment that have either the Infantry or Cavalry Unit Type:

Sliscus' Dole: If the Unit for which this Prime Advantage is selected does not have the Combat Drugs Trait, it gains the [Combat Drugs] Trait. If that Unit already has the [Combat Drug] Trait, then when selecting Combat Drugs a second Combat Drug Trait may be selected for that unit.

Sliscus' Reward: All Weapons with the Splinter Trait used by models in the Unit for which this Prime Advantage is selected have their variant of the Poisoned (X) Special Rule replaced with Poisoned (2+).

units.name: Lady Malys

unitRules.name: Precognisant
unitRules.text: During the first round of a Challenge involving Malys, the opposing player must always select the first Gambit, even if she is not the Challenger, and she gains Challenge Advantage. So long as Malys is involved in a Challenge, she always has Challenge Advantage and cannot lose it, and her opponent cannot gain Challenge Advantage.

unitRules.name: Mind Like a Steel Trap
unitRules.text: Whenever Malys' Unit is selected as the Target Unit of a Reaction made by the Opposing Player, Malys' Controlling Player may have the Reactive Unit, or one other Enemy Unit within 12" of that Unit, gain the Stunned status.

units.note: Plasma Grenades listed as Wargear but no profile/rules text is printed on this page.

units.name: Asdrubael Vect

unitRules.name: Ten Moves Ahead
unitRules.text: If Vect is part of an army, then at the start of each of the Opposing Player's Turns, Vect's Controlling Player gains one additional Reaction Point so long as Vect has not been destroyed.
unitRules.note: 'Ten Moves Ahead' is not listed among the bulleted Special Rules on page 102 (which lists 'The Living Dark Muse' but not this rule by name); its full text is printed at the top of the Special Rules box on page 103, so it is recorded here as one of Vect's rules as printed.

unitRules.name: Ancient Nemesis
unitRules.text: All Melee attacks made by Vect targeting a unit that includes any Models with the Asuryani, Anhrathe, Drukhari, Exodite or Saedath Trait gain +1 to the To Hit roll.

unitRules.name: The Living Dark Muse
unitRules.text:
If a Model with this Special Rule is part of an Army, then the Controlling Player may apply the following additional Special Rules to all Auxiliary, Apex and Primary Detachments that have the Drukhari Trait:
• If four or more Troops Battlefield Role Slots in the Primary Detachment of this Army are filled with units with the Kabals trait, then all Force Organisation Slots with the Troops Battlefield Role in the Primary Detachment are considered Prime Slots.
• Friendly Models with the Drukhari Trait in any Detachment with the Drukhari Trait in the same Army, except Vect himself, that are engaged in a challenge can have the following Gambit selected for them:
The Eye of Vect: If this Gambit is selected, then during the Focus Step the controlling player may choose a number between 1 and 3 and apply the penalty to their Focus roll. Then, during the Strike Step, the controlling player selects a number of the following characteristics of the Model to improve by +1 during that Step, up to the number of the penalty they inflicted to their Focus roll: Weapon Skill, Strength, and/or Attacks. If the model does not win the Challenge, then during the Glory Step the opposing model automatically gains Challenge Advantage regardless of the result.
unitRules.note: Source header on page 102 reads 'Living Dark Muse' in the bulleted Special Rules list but 'The Living Dark Muse' in the boxed Special Rules text on page 103; both kept as printed in each location.

The Dais of Destruction may only be selected in an Army that includes Asdrubael Vect. If the Days of Destruction is selected, Vect must begin the battle Embarked upon it.

While Vect is Embarked upon the Dais of Destruction, the Dais of Destruction uses Vect's Ballistic Skill Characteristic in place of its own.

unitRules.name: Ablation Field

units.name: Drazhar

unitRules.name: Master of Blades
unitRules.text:
While a Model with this Special Rule is engaged in a Challenge, its Controlling Player can select one of the following Gambits for that Model:

Darting Strike: If this Gambit is selected, the Model must use the Mantis Stance of the Executioner's Demiklaives when making Attacks during the Strike Step of the Challenge. This Gambit has no effect during the Focus or the Strike Step; however, if this Model wins the challenge, or during the Glory Step if the Model for which this Gambit was selected has Challenge Advantage, the Controlling Player can select another Enemy Model in the same Combat that would be eligible to issue or accept a Challenge. The Model for which this Gambit was selected is not engaged in a Challenge with that model, replacing the previous Challenge Opponent if that Model had not been destroyed.

Strike Back: If this Gambit is selected, the Model must use the Scorpion Stance of the Executioner's Demiklaives when making Attacks during the Strike Step of the Challenge. During the Strike Step of the Challenge, for each succesful Armour and/or Invulnerable Save Roll made for the Model for which this Gambit was selected, then at the end of Step 3 of the Strike Step, the Enemy Model suffers one additional Hit that has a Strength equal to the result of the Saving Throw, an AP of 2, a Damage of 1 and no Special Rules. Those Hits are counted as Hits inflicted by the Model for which this Challenge was selected during the Strike Step in which they occured.

unitRules.name: Father of Incubi
unitRules.text:
If a Model with this Special Rule is part of an Army, then the Controlling Player may apply the following additional Special Rules to all Auxiliary, Apex and Primary Detachments that have Drukhari Trait:
• The Controlling Player can select up to 1 Retinue Slot in a Detachment of the same Army for every 1000 points of Game Size that is filled with an Incubi Chamber Unit. Each selected Detachment becomes a Prime Slot.
• Units of Incubi Chambers cannot gain the Routed status unless Drazhar has been destroyed.

wargear.name: Clone Field
wargear.text: A Model with a Clone Field has a 4+ Invulnerable Save.

wargear.name: Bladevanes
wargear.text: Bladevanes allow a Model to make 2 Flyby Attacks at S4, AP4.
wargear.note: Vehicle Implement; see the Flyby Attack Special Rule for details on how to perform a Flyby Attack.

wargear.name: Chain Snares
wargear.text: Chain Snares allow a Model to make 3 Flyby Attacks at S4, AP–. If, after resolving the Flyby Attack, the Target Unit suffered any Wounds caused by Chain Snares (regardless of wether any Damage was inflicted), the Target Unit must take a Cool test with a -1 modifier to its Cool Characteristic. If it is failed, the Target Unit gains the Pinned Status.
wargear.note: Vehicle Implement; see the Flyby Attack Special Rule for details on how to perform a Flyby Attack.

wargear.name: Cluster Caltrops
wargear.text: Cluster Caltrops allow a Model to make 4 Flyby Attacks at S6, AP4. If, after resolving the Flyby Attack, the Target Unit suffered any Wounds caused by Cluster Caltrops (regardless of wether any Damage was inflicted), the Target Unit must take a Cool test with a -1 modifier to its Cool Characteristic. If it is failed, the Target Unit gains the Suppressed Status.
wargear.note: Vehicle Implement; see the Flyby Attack Special Rule for details on how to perform a Flyby Attack.

wargear.name: Grav-Talon
wargear.text: A Grav-Talon allows a Model to make 4 Flyby Attacks at S4, AP4. If, after resolving the Flyby Attack, the Target Unit suffered any Wounds caused by a Grav-Talon (regardless of wether any Damage was inflicted), the Target Unit must take a Cool test with a -1 modifier to its Cool Characteristic. If it is failed, the Target Unit gains the Stunned Status.
wargear.note: Vehicle Implement; see the Flyby Attack Special Rule for details on how to perform a Flyby Attack.

wargear.name: Sicklevanes
wargear.text: Sicklevanes allow a Model to make 4 Flyby Attacks at S6, AP4.
wargear.note: Vehicle Implement; see the Flyby Attack Special Rule for details on how to perform a Flyby Attack.

wargear.name: Scythevanes
wargear.text: Scythevanes allow a Model to make 4 Flyby Attacks at S8, AP3 and with the Armourbane Special Rule.
wargear.note: Vehicle Implement; see the Flyby Attack Special Rule for details on how to perform a Flyby Attack.

wargear.name: Enhanced Aethersails
wargear.text: The Controlling Player of a Rapid Vehicle equipped with Enhanced Aethersails may have that model move an additional 12" instead of 6" when making a Rush move.

wargear.name: Flickerfield
wargear.text: A Model with a Flickerfield gains a 5+ Invulnerable Save unless it has the Pinned Status.

wargear.name: Gang Banner
wargear.text: When resolving a Combat in the Resolution Sub-Phase of the Assault Phase, score 1 Combat Resolution Point for each Unit in that Combat that has any Models that have a Gang Banner.

wargear.name: Grisly Trophies
wargear.text: A Model with Grisly Trophies gains the Fear (1) Special Rule.

wargear.name: Night Shield
wargear.text: A Model with a Night Shield gains the Shrouded (5+) Special Rule unless it has the Pinned status.

wargear.name: Plasma Grenades
wargear.text:
When making Volley Attacks during Step 4 of the Charge Procedure with a Unit that includes at least one Model with Plasma Grenades, the Controlling Player may choose to make a single attack with a Plasma Grenade instead of making a normal Shooting Attack using the following profile:
R 6, FP 1, RS 4, AP 4, D 1, Special Rules: Blast (3), Traits: Assault.

wargear.name: Razorwing Familiar
wargear.text: All Models in a Unit that includes a Model with a Razorwing Familiar gain the Move Through Cover Special Rule.

wargear.name: Shadow Field
wargear.text: A model with a Shadow Field has a 2+ Invulnerable Save so long as it has not suffered Damage during the battle. Once the model has suffered Damage during the battle (even if it later regains Wounds), the Shadow Field no longer provides an Invulnerable Save for the remainder of the battle.

wargear.name: Shock Prow
wargear.text: When a Vehicle with a Shock Prow moves through an enemy Unit, the number of Hits inflicted is increased from D6 to D6+3.

wargear.name: Soul-Trap
wargear.text:
The following Gambit can be selected for a Model with a Soul-Trap:
Capture the Soul: If the Challenge Opponent of the model is reduced to 0 Wounds during the Strike step of this round of the challenge, the Model's Controlling Player gains 1 Victory Point and the Model's Strength characteritic is increased by +1 for the remainder of the battle.

wargear.name: Splinter Racks
wargear.text: All Models that are Embarked on a Transport with Splinter Racks, or have Disembarked from a Transport with Splinter Racks in the same turn, gain a +1 modifier to the FP Characteristic of any Weapon with the Splinter Trait that it uses to make shooting attacks.

wargear.name: Tormentors
wargear.text: If a Unit that includes any Models equipped with Tormentors becomes locked in combat because it either charged or was charged in the current Charge Sub-Phase, that Unit's Controlling Player selects Torment (Pinned), Torment (Stunned) or Torment (Suppressed). All Melee weapons used by Models in that Unit that are equipped with Tormentors gain the selected rule, until the end of the current turn.

wargear.name: Vexator Mask
wargear.text:
The following Gambit can be selected for a Model with a Soul-Trap:
False Visage: The Controlling Player of the Challenge Opponent must take a Willpower test for that Model. That test is made with a -2 penalty to the roll if this is the first round of the Challenge. If the test is failed, the Challenge Opponent suffers a Penalty to its Focus Roll equal to the amount it failed by.
wargear.note: The source text introduces this Gambit with 'The following Gambit can be selected for a Model with a Soul-Trap', copy-pasted verbatim from the Soul-Trap entry above; kept as printed even though this item is Vexator Mask, not Soul-Trap.

wargear.name: Webway Portal
wargear.text: Once per battle, when a Model with a Webway Portal is selected during its Controlling Player's Movement phase, but before or after it has moved, the Controlling Player may activate the Webway Portal. If doing so, place a 3" Blast Marker anywhere within 3" of the Model with the Webway Portal until the end of the current turn. Until the end of the current turn, the edge of the Blast Marker is counted as a Battlefield Edge that is within the Controlling Player's Deployment Zone for the purpose of all game rules, special rules and mission objectives.

specialRules.name: Additional Reaction Point
specialRules.text: If an Army's Primary Detachment is from the Drukhari Army List, the Controlling Player gains one additional Reaction Point if that Detachment contains any Models with the Rulers of the Dark City Trait.

specialRules.name: Acid Shock (X)
specialRules.text:
Horrific concoctions, devised to kill slowly and painfully, seeped through the cracks of armour and made light of enhanced flesh.

Each time an Armour Save or Feel No Pain roll is made against a Wound inflicted by a weapon with this special rule, the value in brackets is subtracted from the roll (to a minimum of 1).

specialRules.name: Altered Physiology
specialRules.text: Models with this Special Rule always count their own Unit as having a Status for the purpose of the purpose of the Power From Pain Special Rule, even if the Unit does not have a Status. This only apply to the Model's own Unit; other Units

specialRules.name: Anathema
specialRules.text:
A Unit which includes any Models with this Special Rule may never be selected as the target of a Psychic Blessing or Psychic Curse, and Models with this Special Rule ignore all Damage inflicted by Psychic Weapons, Psychic Powers, Psychic Reactions or Perils of the Warp. If such a Model is selected as the Target Model of any attack or wound inflicted by a Psychic Weapon, Psychic Power, Psychic Reaction, or Perils of the Warp then all Damage caused has no effect and no Wound Tests, Armour Saves or Damage Mitigation Tests are made.

Additionally, Wound Tests made for Weapons with the Psychic or Immaterial Trait that target any Unit that includes only Models with this Special Rule that have an unmodified result of 1, 2, 3 or 4 are never successful, regardless of the Strength Characteristic of a Hit or any Special Rules that set the Target Number for Wound Tests. This Special Rule has no effect on Armour Penetration Tests.

specialRules.name: Ancillary
specialRules.text: A model that is equipped with a Weapon that has this special rule can make a number of additional Attacks in the Fight Sub-Phase, or the Strike Step of a Challenge, equal to the Attack Modifier Characteristic of that weapon. Those additional Attacks must be made using that Weapon, even if a different Weapon was selected for the Model to Fight with in that Phase.

specialRules.name: Dodge (X)
specialRules.text:
A Model with the Dodge (X) Special Rule has an Invulnerable Save equal to the value in brackets associated with the specific variant of this Special Rule against Wounds inflicted by Attacks that were made in any of the following situations:
• The Attack was made during the Assault Phase,
• The Attack was made as part of a Reaction.

specialRules.name: Drain (X)
specialRules.text: During Step 9 of the Shooting Attack process, Step 8 of the Initiative Step of the Fight Sub-Phase or Step 4 of the Challenge process, if a model has caused Damage to an enemy model using a weapon that has the Drain (X) special rule in the current phase, that model gains a number of Wounds equal to the greatest value of X associated with a weapon that has the Drain (X) special rule that the model has caused Damage with in the current phase. This cannot cause a model's Wounds characteristic to be greater than its starting Wounds characteristic.

specialRules.name: Ensnare (X)
specialRules.text:
If a Melee Attack made for a Weapon or Model with this Special Rule inflicts one or more wounds on a Target Unit, regardless of whether any Damage is inflicted, then if in the Aftermath Step of the Resolution Sub-Phase of the curent Combat Phase an Aftermath Option is selected for the Target Unit that allows that Unit to Move, the distance moved is reduced by the value of X associated with the specific variant of the Ensnare special rule, down to a minimum of 0".

Multiple Wounds with the Ensnare Special Rule are not cumulative. If multiple Wounds with the Ensnare Special Rule are inflicted on the same Target Unit, only the greatest value of X associated with the Ensnare Special Rule among those Wounds is used to determin the reduction.

specialRules.name: Firing Deck (X)
specialRules.text:
In the Shooting Phase, a Unit that is Embarked on a Transport Model that has this Special Rule can be selected to make a Shooting Attack, even though it is not on the Battlefield. A number of Embarked Models up to the value noted in the specific variant of the Firing Deck (X) Special Rule may attack as part of that Shooting Attack, and the Shooting Attack must target an Enemy Unit which is in one of the Facings of the Transport noted in the specific variant of the Firing Deck (X) Special Rule. Models making Attacks as part of that Shooting Attack count as having moved if the Transport moved in the preceding Movement Phase and as Stationary if it did not, but must make Attacks as Snap Shots if the Transport moved a number of inches higher than half its Movement Characteristic in the preceding Movement Phase. Ranges are measured from the Hull of the Transport. Reactions made against the Attack that would Target the Unit Target the Transport it is Embarked on instead.

Whenever the Transport that has the Firing Deck (X) Special Rule is selected as the Reacting Unit for a Reaction that allows the Reacting Unit to make a Shooting Attack, the Controlling Player may opt to have the Embarked Unit make that Shooting Attack instead, following the same restrictions as listed above.

specialRules.name: Fleshcraft (X)
specialRules.text:
In the Controlling Player's Movement Phase as the Active Player, when a Model with the Battlesmith (X) Special Rule has been selected, but either before or after it has been moved, the Controlling Player of that Model may activate this Special Rule. Once activated, the Controlling Player of the Model with the Battlesmith (X) Special Rule (referred to as the 'Acting Model') must select one friendly Model within 6" of the Acting Model. The Model selected must have the Infantry, Cavalry or Paragon Type and is referred to as the Target Model'. Once a Target Model has been selected, the Player controlling the Acting Model must make an Intelligence Check for the Acting Model. If the Check is failed there is no further effect, but if the Check is passed then the Player controlling the Acting Model may select one of the following options:
• Reknit: The Target Model gains a number of Wounds equal to the value of X in the Fleshcraft (X) Special Rule variant possessed by the Acting Model. This cannot increase the Target Model's Wounds above its Base Value.
• Restore: A number of Statuses equal to the value of X in the Fleshcraft (X) Special Rule variant possessed by the Acting Model may be removed from the Target Model.
specialRules.note: The source text names the trigger Model's Special Rule 'Battlesmith (X)' throughout this entry's body, although the entry itself is headed 'Fleshcraft (X)' and its options reference 'the Fleshcraft (X) Special Rule variant possessed by the Acting Model'. Kept verbatim; this looks like a leftover name from another codex's version of this rule that was not fully renamed.

specialRules.name: Murderous Assault (X)
specialRules.text:
Any Wound Test made for an Attack made by a Model with the Murderous Assault (X) with a value equal to or higher than the value of X associated with the specific variant of the Murderous Assault (X) Special Rule is automatically succesful, regardless of the target's Toughness characteristic.

At the end of Step 8 of the Initiative Step for any Strike Group that includes attacks made by Models with the Murderous Assault (X) Special Rule, create a new Strike Group that must then be selected in Step 10 and resolved. This new Strike Group includes a number of Attacks equal to the number of Wound Tests with a value equal to or higher than the value of X associated with the specific variant of the Murderous Assault (X) Special Rule caused by the Strike Group that triggered its creation. These Attacks are made by the model that made the Attack that triggered the Murderous Strike (X) Special Rule and have a Strength, AP and Damage Characteristics equal to those of the Attack that triggered the Murderous Assault (X) Special Rule, but have no Special Rules.

specialRules.name: Flyby Attack
specialRules.text:
Certain Wargear Items allow a Model to make a special kind of Attack called a Flyby Attack. After a Unit that includes any Models with a Special Rule that allows it to make a Flyby Attack has moved in the Controlling Player's Movement Phase as the Active Player, the Controlling Player can Target one Enemy Unit that Unit moved through or over to make a Flyby Attack using all Models in the Unit that have a Wargear Item that allows the Model to make a Flyby Attack. Resolve a Shooting Attack Procedure against the Target of the Flyby Attack, applying the following modifications:
• Skip Step 2. Hits inflicted on a Model with the Vehicle Type always target that model's Rear Armour.
• During Step 3, instead of declaring Weapons, the Controlling Player of the Unit making the Flyby Attack declares one Wargear Item which allows the Model to make Flyby Attack for each Model in the Unit that is taking part in the Flyby Attack.
• During Step 4, each Fire Group is comprised of all Wargear Items with the same Name.
• During Step 6, instead of rolling To Hit, each attacking Model inflicts a number of Automatic Hits on the Target Unit. The number of Hits inflicted as well as their Strength, AP, and Special Rules are listed in the specific Wargear Item that allows the Model to make a Flyby Attack.
• After resolving Step 11, proceed with the Movement Phase as normal.

specialRules.name: Pain Amp
specialRules.text: Whenever an Attack made with a Weapon that has the Pain Amp Special Rule causes a Hit against an Enemy Unit that has one or more of the Pinned, Suppressed, Stunned or Routed Tactical Status, that Hit receives a +1 Modifier to the Strength or Ranged Strength Characteristic of the Attack.

specialRules.name: Pain Engine
specialRules.text:
A Unit that includes any models with the Pain Engine Special Rule is subject to the following provisions:
• Models cannot join the Unit, with the exception of Models with the Covens Trait.
• The Unit cannot be selected as the Reactive Unit for any Reaction.
• A Unit that includes any Models with this Special Rule is unaffected by the effects of Tactical Status. Status Tokens can still be placed on Models in the Unit, but they have no effect.
• The Unit begins the battle with the Stunned Tactical Status.

specialRules.name: Phantom Shields (X)
specialRules.text:
A Model with this Special Rule has a number of phantom shields equal to the value of X. While a Model with this Special Rule still has phantom shields, each time that Model suffers a Hit from a Shooting Attack it must be allocated to the phantom shields. Once all void shields have collapsed, any remaining Hits from Shooting Attacks must be allocated to the model (or Titan Profile in the case of a Titan) targeted by the attack.

A phantom shield has an Armour Value of 12, and any Glancing Hit or Penetrating Hit inflicted on it will cause that void shield to collapse. Regardless of the Damage value of a Hit it may not collapse more than one phantom shield, and once a Hit has collapsed a phantom shield or failed an Armour Penetration Test made against one it is discarded.

If, in the Effects Sub-Phase of the Controlling Player's End Phase, a model has any collapsed phantom shields, but still has at least one phantom shield still active, all collapsed phantom shields are restored. Once all of a model's phantom shields have collapsed, they never restore.

Phantom shields are counted as void shields for the purpose of the Shield-Breaker special rule.

specialRules.name: Pierce (X)
specialRules.text: When an Armour Penetration Test is made for an attack made with a weapon that has the Pierce (X) special rule, the value in brackets associated with the specific variants of this special rule is added to the result of the Armour Penetration Test.

specialRules.name: Power From Pain
specialRules.text:
A Model that has this Special Rule gains a number of cumulative benefits, depending on the number of Units (friend and enemy) within 6" of its Unit that have one or more of the Pinned, Suppressed, Stunned or Routed Tactical Status. Note that the Model's own Unit is also counted towards the total:
• 1+ Units: The Model gains the Feel No Pain (5+) Special Rule.
• 2+ Units: The Model gains a +1 modifier to its Strength and Attacks Characteristics.
• 3+ Units: The Model's base Leadership, Cool, Willpower and Intelligence Characteristics become 12.

specialRules.name: Predator's Sight
specialRules.text: Whenever a Model with this Special Rule makes a Shooting Attack, targeting a Unit that has one or more of the Pinned, Suppressed, Stunned or Routed Tactical Status, the Model gains a +1 modifier to its Ballistic Skill for that Shooting Attack (including when firing Snap Shots).

specialRules.name: Psy-Shock
specialRules.text: If a Shooting Attack made for a Weapon or Model with this Special Rule inflicts one or more wounds on a Target Unit which contains any Models with the Psyker Trait or Malefic Sub-Type, regardless of whether any Damage is inflicted, that Target Unit suffers the Warp Rupture resulton the Perils of the Warp Table at the end of Step 9 of that Shooting Attack.

specialRules.name: Rain of Cruelty
specialRules.text: A Model with this Special Rule gains the Implacable Advance and Firestorm Special Rules so long as it either is Embarked on a Transport, or has Disembarked from a Transport in the same turn.

specialRules.name: Salvo (X)
specialRules.text: If at least one model in a unit that is targeted by a Shooting Attack made by a Model using a Weapon with this Special Rule is within a range equal to or less than the value specified by X, the Firepower characteristic of that attack is doubled.

specialRules.name: Scourge (X)
specialRules.text:
When making a Wound Test for an attack with the Scourge (X) Special Rule, the Characteristic indicated in brackets is used instead of the Target's Toughness Characteristic. If the Attack Target has "-" listed instead of that Characteristic, the Wound Test automatically fails.

When making an Armour Penetration Test for an attack with the Scourge (X) Special Rule, the Armour Value of the Target is used as normal, but any Penetrating Hits scored become Glancing Hits instead.

specialRules.name: Shadow Gate
specialRules.text:
If a Shooting Attack made for a Weapon or Model with this Special Rule causes any Hits against a Target Model with the Vehicle or Walker Type, then until the end of the current Shooting Phase, each time an Invulnerable Save or Shrouded Damage Mitigation Roll is made for the Target Model, subtract 1 from the roll to a minimum of 1. The same Model can only be affected by this effect of the Shadow Gate Special Rule once per Shooting Phase.

If the Target Model has the Void Shield (X) Special Rule, then do not apply the previous effect of the Shadow Gate Special Rule. Instead, roll a D6. On a 3+, reduce the value in brackets associated with that Modl's Void Shield (X) Special Rule by 1, to a minimum of 0. The same Model can be affected by this effect of the Shadow Gate Special Rule any number of times per Shooting Phase.

specialRules.name: Spirit Leech
specialRules.text: Each time an Attack is made using a weapon that has this Special Rule, its Strength (or Ranged Strength) characteristic is doubled if the Target Unit has any kind of Tactical Status.

specialRules.name: Storm of Infamy
specialRules.text: A Model with this Special Rule fires Snap Shots using its full Ballistic Skill. All other penalties relating to Snap Shots still apply.

specialRules.name: Take Captives
specialRules.text:
When a Unit that is composed entirely of Models with this Special Rule is on the winning side of a Combat, the Take Captives aftermath option may be selected for that Unit as long as at least one Enemy Model engaged in that Combat had its last Wound removed during that turn of Combat:

Take Captives: A Unit that chooses to Take Captives cannot move or make any attacks as part of this aftermath option, but instead has 1 Captive Token placed on it.

specialRules.name: Captive Tokens
specialRules.text:
Captive Tokens are normally only used only to keep track of the points scored through the Take Captives Special Rule, and have no other effect on the game unless directly called out by another Special Rule. Captives Token can be represented using tokens or by simply leaving slain enemy models next to the Unit with the Captive Token. A Unit can have any number of Captive Tokens placed on it.
• If the Unit that has Captive Tokens is entirely destroyed, the Controlling Player scores 1 Victory Point for each Captive Token on the Unit.
• If all Models in the Unit that has Captives Tokens, or, if the Unit is Embarked, the Transport Model that Unit is Embarked on, are within 6" of a Table Edge or in reserves, unengaged, and do not have the Routed status, at the end of the Controlling Player's Movement Phase, that Player removes all Captive Tokens from the Unit and scores 2 Victory Point for each Captive Token removed.
• If a Unit that as Captives Tokens is on the battlefield at the end of the Battle and does not have the Routed status, the Controlling Player scores 2 Victory Points for each Captive Token on the Unit.

specialRules.name: Take Heads
specialRules.text:
When an Enemy Model that has the Champion, Command or Sergeant Sub-Type, or the Paragon Type, loses its last Wound and is destroyed by an Attack made by a Model with this Special Rule, the Controlling Player scores a number of Victory Points, depending on the Types and Sub-Types that Model had. These are not cumulative; if a Model has multiple of the listed Types and Sub-Types, only the option that would result in the most Victory Points being scored is used:
• Sergeant: 1 Victory Point.
• Champion: 2 Victory Points.
• Command: 3 Victory Point.
• Paragon: 5 Victory Points.
specialRules.note: This entry's Victory Point bullet list is printed at the top of p.82 (out of this file's assigned page range), immediately following the paragraph on p.81; included here for a complete rule.

reactions.name: Lightning Reflexes
reactions.text:
Trigger: The Reactive Player may declare a Lightning Reflexes reaction at the start of Step 3 of the Shooting Attack sequence of a Shooting Attack made by the Active Player.

Cost: The Reactive player may spend 1 point from their Reaction Allotment to declare a Lightning Reflexes reaction – the cost is paid as soon as the declaration is made.

Target: The Target unit is always the Unit whose Shooting Attack triggered the Reaction. The Reacting Unit is always the Unit that was the target of the Shooting Attack that triggered the Reaction and must be entirely composed of Models with the Light Sub-Type.

Process:
I. Once a Lightning Reflexes reaction has been declared, each Model in the Reacting Unit may move a number of inches equal to the Base Value of its Initiative Characteristic. If all Models in the Reacting Unit end this move within 2" of any point on a Facing of a Model with the Transport Sub-Type upon which the Unit can Embark, the Unit may Embark upon that Model at the end of that move.
II. After all Models in the Reacting Units have moved, return to Step 2 of the Shooting Attack Sequence. If the Reacting Unit is still a valid target for the Shooting Attack, the Opposing Player may at this point select to either continue resolving the Shooting Attack Sequence against the Reacting Unit or return to Step 1 of the Shooting Attack Sequence and select a different Unit as the Target. If the Reacting Unit is no longer a valid Target for the Shooting Attack, the Opposing Player must return to step 1 of the Shooting Attack Sequence and select another Target.
III. If the Opposing Player returns to Step 1 of the Shooting Attack Sequence and selects another Target for the Shooting Attack, all Models in the Target Unit have a -1 modifier to their Ballistic Skill characteristic for the duration of that Shooting Attack Sequence.

reactions.name: Acrobatic Dodge
reactions.text:
Trigger: The Reactive Player may declare an Acrobatic Dodge reaction at the start of Step 3 of the Shooting Attack sequence of a Shooting Attack made by the Active Player.

Cost: The Reactive player may spend 1 point from their Reaction Allotment to declare an Ethereal Interception reaction – the cost is paid as soon as the declaration is made.

Target: The Target unit is always the Unit whose Shooting Attack triggered the Reaction. The Reacting Unit is always the Unit that was the target of the Shooting Attack that triggered the Reaction and must be entirely composed of Models with the Jink Trait.

Process:
I. Once an Acrobatic Dodge Reaction has been declared, all Models in the Reacting Unit gain the Shrouded (5+) Special Rule against Attacks made by the Target Unit for the duration of this Shooting Attack.
II. Any Models in the Reacting Unit that already have a variant of the Shrouded (X) Special Rule instead receive a +1 modifier to the value of their Shrouded (X) Special Rule (Shrouded (5+) becomes Shrouded (4+), etc), to a maximum of Shrouded (3+).
reactions.note: The printed 'Cost' paragraph names the 'Ethereal Interception' reaction instead of 'Acrobatic Dodge' (apparently copied from the Necron Ethereal Interception reaction of the same shape); kept verbatim as printed.

gambits.name: Macabre Interest
gambits.text:
When selecting a Gambit, the controlling player of a model with the 'Drukhari' Trait can select Macabre Interest instead of any others available to that model.

If this Gambit is selected, then the model controlled by the player that selected it gains the Take Heads Special Rule until the Challenge ends (including in further rounds of combat, if the challenge continues beyond the round during which this Gambit is selected). If the model already had the Take Head Special Rule, then if the Controlling Player would gain Victory Points because the model destroyed its Challenge Opponent, that player scores 1 additional Victory Point.

primeAdvantages.name: Scion of Vileth
primeAdvantages.text:
If a unit with the Drukhari Trait is selected to fill a Prime Force Organization Slot in a Detachment, the Scion of Vileth Prime Advantage may be selected:

This Prime Advantage may only be selected for a Slot that is filled with a Model with the Flyer Sub-Type. The Model for which this Prime Advantage was selected gains gains a +1 modifier to its Ballistic Skill and has a 4+ Invulnerable Save against all Shooting Attacks made as part of Reactions.

If a Unit has the [Partisan] Trait listed instead of a specific option, one of the three Traits above must be selected for it during Army creation.

traits.name: [Combat Drugs]
traits.text: Some Units in the Drukhari Army List will have a Combat Drug represented by a Trait on its Unit Entry, represented by the [Combat Drugs] Trait. When such a Unit is added to an Army, one Combat Drug Trait from the following list must be selected for that Unit. Each Combat Drug Trait that a Unit has improves one Characteristic of the Model that has it, as listed next to the corresponding Combat Drug Trait: Adrenalight (+1 A), Grave Lotus (+1 S), Hypex (+1 I), Painbringer (+1 T), Serpentin (+1 WS), Splintermind (+1 CL). Units do not benefit from the Combat Drugs Trait of Models that Join them, nor do Models that Join a Unit benefit from that Unit's Combat Drug Trait. Some Rules and Special Rules may allow a Model to gain more than one Combat Drug Trait. If this is the case, the Model's Second Combat Drug Traits must be different from the first. A Model that somehow has three or more Combat Drugs Traits at the same time is immediately destroyed.

faq.q: Pain Engine Special Rule: If a Unit that includes models with the Pain Engine Special Rule has a Tactical Status, does it suffer the generic penalties for having a Tactical Status?
faq.a: No. The Unit is unaffected by all effects of Tactical Status, including both the generic penalties for having a Tactical Status and the effects of the specific Tactical Status. The reason the Unit can gain Tactical Status at all is only to support itself and other Units with the Power from Pain special rule.
